records.text: Aleister Crowley created the religion of Thelema and attempted to summon demons in France
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And he even created his own religion around it, religion of Thelema, Black magic. There are so many stories out there regarding Aleister Crowley attempting to summon various demons in France. He tried to summon Pan, I think, in Paris.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Current scholarly references confirm Crowley developed Thelema, but the specific claim that he attempted to summon demons in France was not corroborated by the sources located.
